sentences.l2: 最近几年，人工智能技术发展很快。
sentences.l1: In recent years, artificial intelligence technology has developed very fast.

sentences.l2: 很多人开始使用个人AI助手来帮助学习、工作和生活。
sentences.l1: Many people have begun to use personal AI assistants to help with study, work, and life.

sentences.l2: 一些科技公司推出了开源的AI代理项目，意思是把程序代码公开，让所有人都能查看和修改。
sentences.l1: Some technology companies have launched open-source AI agent projects, meaning that the program code is made public so that everyone can view and modify it.

sentences.l2: 这种做法可以让更多人参与改进技术，也能加快创新的速度。
sentences.l1: This approach can let more people take part in improving the technology, and can also speed up innovation.

sentences.l2: 有人认为，这种开放模式可能代表了未来AI发展的方向。
sentences.l1: Some people think that this open model may represent the direction of future AI development.

sentences.l2: OpenClaw 就是一个开源的通用人工智能代理项目。
sentences.l1: OpenClaw is an open-source general artificial intelligence agent project.

sentences.l2: 它不仅能回答问题、写文章，还能理解复杂的指令，帮用户完成多步骤的任务。
sentences.l1: It can not only answer questions and write articles, but also understand complex instructions and help users complete multi-step tasks.

sentences.l2: 比如，你可以让它整理邮件、安排行程，甚至分析数据。
sentences.l1: For example, you can have it organize emails, arrange itineraries, and even analyze data.

sentences.l2: 因为它对所有人开放，研究人员、开发者和普通用户都可以测试它、提出建议或增加新功能。
sentences.l1: Because it is open to everyone, researchers, developers, and ordinary users can all test it, make suggestions, or add new features.

sentences.l2: 这样一来，它的能力可以不断变强。
sentences.l1: In this way, its capabilities can keep getting stronger.

sentences.l2: 有些人担心，公开AI代码会不会带来安全风险？
sentences.l1: Some people worry: will making AI code public bring security risks?

sentences.l2: 比如被坏人用来做坏事。
sentences.l1: For example, being used by bad people to do bad things.

sentences.l2: 但支持者认为，只要管理得当，开放的好处远大于风险。
sentences.l1: But supporters believe that as long as it is managed properly, the benefits of openness far outweigh the risks.

sentences.l2: 他们相信，通过合作，可以让AI更透明、更公平、更可信。
sentences.l1: They believe that, through cooperation, AI can be made more transparent, fairer, and more trustworthy.

sentences.l2: 到了2026年，也许每个家庭都会有一个AI助手。
sentences.l1: By 2026, perhaps every family will have an AI assistant.

sentences.l2: 如果像OpenClaw这样的开源项目能持续进步，那么未来的AI代理可能会更智能、更便宜，也更容易被大家使用。
sentences.l1: If open-source projects like OpenClaw can keep making progress, then future AI agents may become smarter, cheaper, and easier for everyone to use.

sentences.l2: 虽然现在还有挑战，但很多专家认为，开源模式将在其中发挥重要作用。
sentences.l1: Although there are still challenges now, many experts believe that the open-source model will play an important role in it.

sentences.l2: 这不仅改变了技术的发展方式，也可能改变我们与AI共处的方式。
sentences.l1: This not only changes the way technology develops, but may also change the way we coexist with AI.
